title.orig: An Act Declaring November 28 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Municipality of Santa Margarita, Province of Samar, in Commemoration of Its Founding Anniversary, to be Known as the "Santa Margarita Foundation Day"

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2019/ra_11183_2019.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: - November 28 of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking day in the Municipality of Santa Margarita, Province of Samar, in commemoration of its founding anniversary, to be known as the "Santa Margarita Founding Day". When the holiday falls on a Saturday or Sunday, the special nonworking day shall be observed on the Monday that follows.
- This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
